title: Cursor MCP JSON: Add Any Tool to Your AI Agent in 5 Minutes
summary: Learn how to configure MCP servers in Cursor using the mcp.json file. Complete guide to adding tools, authentication, and the one command that skips manual config entirely.
body_markdown: Cursor's built-in tools (file read/write, terminal, web search) are always available. MCP tools extend this with external system access — your specific database, your GitHub repos, your Blink workspace. The agent treats both the same way and calls them based on what the task requires. Blink adds 80+ MCP tools on top of Cursor's built-in set.
